source_row.rationale: Dextromethorphan, a common OTC cough suppressant, has recognized abuse potential at doses significantly higher than recommended, since it can produce dissociative and hallucinogenic effects at high doses. This is an important safety consideration, particularly relevant to counseling for adolescent clients, given documented patterns of recreational misuse ("robotripping") in this population.
source_row.source_detail: Recognized Abuse Potential at High Doses
source_row.source_name: FDA — Dextromethorphan Abuse and Misuse Concerns
